description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to Duties and Functions (State Minister of Defence, State Minister of Disaster Management, Minister of Wildlife and Anest Resources Conservation)
categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific government official (Gotabaya Rajapaksa, President) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities for two State Ministers (Defence and Disaster Management). It outlines specific subjects, functions, special priorities, and the related institutional and legal framework for each ministry, meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
